subject: opensquilla
title: Injection prose overclaim: tool results are never screened or wrapped, and the refusal path has no producer

subject: opensquilla
title: Provider-boundary repetition guard immune to delta-splitting
evidence: src/opensquilla/engine/repetition_guard.py:1-6 (checkpointed character-stream detector upstream of agent events, request closed before terminal error)
one_why: Canonical confirmation under loop-detection (crush's 7-rung anchor breaker): opensquilla detects on normalized characters at fixed checkpoints, so a provider cannot dodge detection by chunking the same degenerate text differently - strictly stronger than output-line-based breakers, and the placement makes every channel benefit.
